Design scope

What the architecture covers

Let the land lead the design. We place the house, arrival, outdoor rooms and services around views, privacy, climate and the realities of a rural site.

01Site placementPosition buildings around sun, views, privacy, access and existing site features.
02Arrival and movementPlan gates, drives, parking and service access across a larger property.
03Indoor-outdoor livingConnect living spaces to verandas, lawns, courts and shaded terraces.
04Infrastructure planningAllow for water, drainage, power, waste and site service routes.
05Landscape integrationCoordinate building levels, planting zones and outdoor uses from the start.
06Architectural packageDevelop plans, elevations, sections and details for construction.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Infrastructure and landscape

Coordinate utilities, drainage, external levels and landscape around the building plan.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedSite planning, building concept, exterior design, working drawings and coordination.
Final feeThe final proposal reflects site area, number of structures, infrastructure and landscape coordination.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 800K–2M

The final proposal reflects site area, number of structures, infrastructure and landscape coordination.

Request a proposal

After architecture

Carry the idea into the interior

Woodex can develop the interior design once the farmhouse architecture is approved, then price fit-out separately.
